articles.title: Scottish Premiership: McInnes booed in Rangers draw at Hearts as Celtic also earn point
articles.summary: Derek McInnes was making first return to Tynecastle. Martin O’Neill ‘disappointed’ after Dundee United result. Olwethu Makhanya scored a late equaliser as Rangers earned a 2-2 draw with Hearts on the much-hyped Tynecastle return for Derek McInnes.
body: The Rangers manager was booed loudly by the home support as he emerged from the tunnel for his first match back since leaving for Ibrox in June, just weeks after the Edinburgh side were pipped to the Scottish Premiership title.
However, his team silenced a pumped-up home crowd when Kevin Kelsy scored a 16th-minute opener after a lapse from Laurent Mendy.

Hearts turned the game round with goals from Cláudio Braga and Calvin Miller early in the second half. But Makhanya’s 89th-minute header ensured the match ended all square, keeping second-placed Rangers four points behind Celtic and four above Hearts.
Celtic showed their mettle as they fought back to grab a 2-2 draw with Dundee United at Parkhead.

articles.title: Carabao Cup roundup: Bournemouth thrash Villa, Sunderland salvo stings Bees
articles.summary: Cherries win 3-0 to set up Anfield visit in last eight. Wearsiders resist Brentford fightback in 3-2 success. Bournemouth continued their impressive run of results by thumping Aston Villa 3-0 to reach the Carabao Cup quarter-finals for the first time in eight seasons, while Sunderland scored three…
body: The winger Amine Adli fired home in the seventh minute at the Vitality Stadium to set Marco Rose’s in-form side on course for a fifth consecutive win in all competitions. Lewis Cook, the Cherries captain, added a fortuitous second early in the second period before the striker Álvaro Rodríguez sealed another 3-0 success after similar wins against Milan and Manchester United.

Villa – five-time League Cup winners – were second best for most of a fruitless trip to the south coast as they endured a first defeat in eight games. Taylor Harwood-Bellis and the substitutes Alejandro Garnacho and Alysson had the visitors’ best chances in Dorset but Bournemouth registered a fifth clean sheet in a row to ease into the last eight.
Both sides made wholesale changes for the fourth-round tie. Adli – one of eight players brought in by Rose, the Bournemouth head coach, finished a fine team move to open the scoring.

After James Tavernier unlocked the visitors’ defence with a delightful ball over the top, the full-back Julio Soler delivered a lofted cross from the left, allowing the Morocco international Adli to fire into the top-right corner from six yards out.

articles.title: How unbeaten Chelsea are getting back to their best
articles.summary: Chelsea are getting back to their best following their 2-0 Women's Champions League win over Roma - so how have they built success in their unbeaten run?
body: Chelsea's 2-0 victory over Roma in the Women's Champions League was yet another demonstration they can win in different ways.
Sonia Bompastor's side disappointed last season when they lost their Women's Super League and FA Cup crowns, while rivals Arsenal handed them an exit from Europe at the quarter-final stage.
That followed a dream unbeaten season in which the Blues wrapped up a domestic treble in Bompastor's first year in charge.
Having previously won six successive WSL titles, a blip was inevitable and their transition period highlighted flaws in the new era under their French boss.

articles.title: Liverpool beat Chelsea on penalties yet again to secure Carabao Cup progress
articles.summary: Chelsea must have known their fate as soon as the last 16 tie at Anfield went to penalties. Four times they had faced Liverpool in a penalty shoot-out previously and four times they had lost.
body: The defender was not the only culprit as Chelsea’s catalogue of penalty misery against Liverpool gained a new chapter to add to the 2007 Champions League semi-final, the 2019 Uefa Super Cup final and the FA and League Cup finals of 2022. Emmanuel Emegha could have won it for Xabi Alonso’s visitors but his effort was saved superbly by Giorgi Mamardashvili.

Kostas Tsimikas could also have reprised his match-winning role from Wembley in 2022 but fired over when Liverpool were a kick away from the last eight. Ryan Gravenberch and Valentin Barco also failed to convert in the shootout after Morgan Rogers and Cody Gakpo had both scored penalties in normal time.

Former Liverpool midfielders Alonso and Jordan Henderson received lukewarm receptions on their return to Anfield, certainly in comparison to previous visits with Bayer Leverkusen, Real Madrid and Brentford. That was the best they could have hoped for given the club they were returning with. The Chelsea manager was warmly embraced before kick-off by his childhood friend Iraola, however, while Henderson had to make do with some pantomime booing whenever he took possession.

articles.title: Alessia Russo makes history with hat-trick as Arsenal cruise to Benfica win
articles.summary: Alessia Russo wrote herself into the history books once again as she became the highest English goal-scorer in the Women’s Champions League. Her hat-trick gave Arsenal a 3-0 win over Benfica to send the Gunners up to second in the league phase table.
body: It is safe to say that Arsenal’s season has yet to fully burst into life. Struggles in front of goal, unforced errors and rather lackadaisical performances have defined the opening two months. Saturday’s north London derby win did, however, feel like it could be a springboard for some much-needed momentum, a gritty performance that could kickstart Renée Slegers’ side into life.

There was no less pressure coming into this match. Taking on the Portuguese champions at home felt like another must-win encounter with their European form having mirrored their domestic struggles to date. A last-ditch win over HB Køge and heartbreaking draw against Paris FC (in which they surrendered a two-goal lead) left them fifth before kick-off, with the spectres of Barcelona and OL Lyonnes looming on the horizon.

While Taylor Hinds and Caitlin Foord retained their places after an impressive showing against Tottenham, Slegers made three changes to freshen things up. Ona Batlle returned to her more natural right-back position while summer signings Élisa De Almeida and Géraldine Reuteler made their full debuts.

articles.summary: Geronimo Rulli's penalty shootout heroics may have put the pressure on Gianluigi Donnarumma at Manchester City, but manager Enzo Maresca has no doubt about his number one.
body: Rulli returned to the club in the summer from Marseille for a modest £1.7m to feature as a back-up to the Italy captain, but seemed to press his claims to challenge the jersey with an impressive display.
The 34-year-old dived full stretch to his left to save the last two penalties from Brighton's Yasin Ayari and Lewis Dunk to allow holders City to progress to the quarter-finals of the competition.
The match had ended 2-2 in normal time and would not have gone all the way had Rulli not made a sensational fingertip save to deny Georginio Rutter in the second half.
Veteran Rulli will be back on the bench though for this weekend's Premier League game against the same opposition - despite Donnarumma's form being questioned by many in recent weeks.

articles.summary: Bayern Munich head coach Vincent Kompany has ‌been discharged from hospital following his collapse in training last week ‌due to a meningeal irritation, board member for ​sports Max Eberl said on Wednesday.
body: Kompany was taken to hospital last week after collapsing at Bayern's training ground during ‌a second-team training session.
He missed out on media duties ahead of Bayern's Champions League match against Arsenal due to a viral infection, but did make it to the dugout for the 2-2 draw.

"Given the circumstances, he's doing ⁠well," Eberl told broadcaster ARD ⁠ahead of the German Cup game against Magdeburg, who Bayern beat 6-1. "He ‌was discharged from the hospital today [Wednesday]. That is the biggest and best news for all of ‌us.
"It's a meningeal irritation that caused this incident on Friday. He will now rest and take medication and I am certain that he will ⁠very soon be back on the ​touchline, operating at 100 per cent."

articles.title: History-maker Russo scores hat-trick as Arsenal dismiss Benfica
articles.summary: Alessia Russo became the highest-ever English goalscorer in Women's Champions League history with a hat-trick against Benfica as Arsenal won 3-0 in their league phase match.
body: The Gunners No 9 matched Fran Kirby's record (21) with her first-half opener - a low, diagonal effort that beat goalkeeper Lena Pauels.

Her next - a glancing header from Steph Catley's corner - made her the outright record holder, before adding another from the penalty spot after Caitlin Foord was fouled by Catarina Amado, taking her to 23 goals.

"She is everything," Arsenal boss Renee Slegers told Disney+ after the game. "It's hard to know where to start. She is such a humble, nice human being, cares for everything and everyone, does everything to the fullest.
"She trains, does meetings, prepares, recovers. Everything is 100 pre cent and she brings so much quality. There is so much to say about Alessia and it's a privilege for me to work with her.

articles.title: Liverpool beat Chelsea on penalties to reach last eight
articles.summary: Wesley Fofana missed the decisive spot kick as Liverpool beat Chelsea on penalties to set up a Carabao Cup quarter-final against Andoni Iraola's former side Bournemouth.
body: Fofana, whose handball gifted Liverpool their equaliser from the spot in normal time, scooped his penalty into the Kop after Giorgi Mamardashvili had denied Chelsea debutant Emmanuel Emegha.

Valentin Barco, another substitute, also missed his spot kick, sending his effort onto the post, but Ryan Gravenberch was thwarted by Mike Penders and Kostas Tsimikas fired over to keep a dramatic shoot-out going before Joe Gomez capitalised on Emegha's miss and Fofana fired over.
The goals also came from the spot in normal time, with Morgan Rogers and Cody Gakpo converting within three minutes of each other as a cagey first half burst into life before the break.
Both penalties were needlessly conceded, with Gravenberch first fouling Moises Caicedo when he was running away from goal, and Fofana then bizarrely raising his hand to touch a Tzimikas corner.

articles.summary: Bayern Munich head coach Vincent Kompany is discharged from hospital and "doing well" following his collapse at the club's training ground, according to a club board member.
body: Bayern Munich head coach Vincent Kompany has been discharged from hospital and is "doing well" following his collapse at the club's training ground.
Kompany, 40, was rushed to hospital last Friday after taking ill as he watched the club's second team train.
The cause has been identified as meningeal irritation - an inflammation of the protective membrane surrounding the brain and spinal cord.
"Given the circumstances, he's doing well," Max Eberl, the club's board member for sports, told German broadcaster ARD on Wednesday.

articles.title: WNBA Finals ticket for under $40? Game 6 matinee turns into a fire sale
articles.summary: The WNBA Finals Game 6 time change from primetime to lunchtime is having a direct impact on ticket prices. The Atlanta Dream announced on Wednesday morning that State Farm Arena sold out its 17,000 capacity arena for the 12:30 p.m.
body: Fans could get into Game 6 for $38 as of Wednesday morning, according to a spokesperson for TicketIQ.com. That's 85% lower than the get-in price for Game 4, which started at $246.

The circumstances aren't ideal for fans who want to watch the WNBA's premier event. The game tips off midday on a weekday, while most are at work or at school. Further, anyone interested in watching the highest-stakes game yet had short notice to alter their Thursday plans.

The WNBA and Dream didn't secure State Farm Arena until Monday morning, a few hours before Game 5, giving fans three days to buy their tickets. The league had to move tipoff from 8 p.m. to 12:30 p.m. ET to accommodate an Atlanta Hawks game on Thursday. That means the Valkyries could be hoisting the championship trophy while West Coast fans are enjoying brunch.
The alternative would have been a primetime tipoff at Gateway Center Arena at College Park, the Dream's home court for a majority of the 2026 season that seats up to 3,500.
points: The WNBA Finals Game 6 time change from primetime to lunchtime is having a direct impact on ticket prices.
The Atlanta Dream announced on Wednesday morning that State Farm Arena sold out its 17,000 capacity arena for the 12:30 p.m.
Fans could get into Game 6 for $38 as of Wednesday morning, according to a spokesperson for TicketIQ.com.
That's 85% lower than the get-in price for Game 4, which started at $246.

articles.summary: Why Cooper Flagg is giving Kendrick Perkins ‘LeBron James-type vibe’ appeared first on ClutchPoints. Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here. The Dallas Mavericks have gotten off to a 2-2 start to the 2026-27 NBA season, but one of the biggest storylines around the league thus far…
body: Cooper Flagg ’s early play for the Mavericks has been good enough that former NBA player turned ESPN analyst Kendrick Perkins is already comparing him to LeBron James.

“When you talk about the most complete players in the game, there’s only a handful of guys I’d put in front of him,” Perkins said during a recent segment of ‘NBA Today.’ “There’s nothing he can’t do. If you need him to get downhill off the pick and roll, he can do that. He’s versatile defensively. He’s bringing it up, he’s setting up the offense. His patience, it gives me LeBron James-type vibes. When he gets in the lane, he’s finishing in traffic.”

Flagg has missed one game this season due a shoulder injury he sustained during the Mavericks’ win against the Indiana Pacers last week, but he’s since returned to the lineup. In the three games he’s played, he’s averaging 25.0 points, 5.3 rebounds, 6.3 assists, 3.7 steals and 1.7 blocked shots with splits of 56.5 percent shooting from the field, 35.7 percent shooting from the 3-point line and 90 percent shooting from the free-throw line.
The Mavericks and Flagg face a big test, however, on Wednesday as they host the Oklahoma City Thunder.

articles.title: Josh Downs Requests Trade From Indy: Who Are The Colts Top Remaining Trade Chips?
articles.summary: The Indianapolis Colts' fire sale is officially underway. With guard Quenton Nelson and defensive tackle DeForest Buckner getting traded on Tuesday, all eyes now shift toward who the Colts will move next.
body: However, more names could be on their way out — and not just expiring contracts. True core pieces of the roster could be moved heading into the NFL trade deadline, including a player few saw as a potential trade target: wide receiver Josh Downs.

It remains to be seen whether the Colts will grant Downs his request, but he stands out as one of their top trade chips ahead of the deadline. If both Taylor and Downs are dealt, it would signal a total overhaul and a full-scale rebuild heading into the offseason.

Downs is just 25 years old and still on his rookie deal, but like Nelson and Buckner, he is set to become an unrestricted free agent this offseason. Through seven games, Downs has caught 26 passes for 307 yards, though he has yet to reach the end zone.

Given the widespread interest in wide receivers before the deadline, Downs fits logically as a target for a handful of teams, like the Los Angeles Rams and Kansas City Chiefs as they're dealing with injuries at the position.
